name: DFW Cubing Winter 2023
information: This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). Note: This competition is on a Sunday. # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2023#23365-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingWinter2023#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 3x3 Finals will be done head to head if time permits.
